ignored_dependency_false_positive.meaning: Installed dependency text: two distribution checksum substrings, authors Eran Shir/N. Moshiri/shireenrao/shirou, shirt-related identifiers, Albanian morphology, and the SHIA top-level domain. No biological ShiA/ShiR entry or pathway source.

maintained_downstream_record.meaning: Complete maintained GO:0019618 record uses the MetaCyc ortho-cleavage source for its four formal reactions from protocatechuate to 3-oxoadipate. Same downstream process; use the established GO identity when connecting the new shikimate route, with source-backed scope mapping.

generated_downstream_projections.meaning: KGX edge export and rendered page derived from maintained GO:0019618; source references repeat the native pathway frame. They are projections of existing downstream coverage, not separate pathway owners.

unrelated_prior_text_false_positive.meaning: Matches are author surname Yoshitsugu Shiro; literal ShiR in an encoded gzip/base64 snapshot; Shirakihara88 citation in phosphofructokinase evidence; Miyashiro T citation in a signaling paper. None denotes the Corynebacterium ShiR regulator. Encoded snapshot contents are not decoded by this text search.

prior_downstream_boundary_search.meaning: Earlier GO/native boundary and preflight inventories identify the known downstream ortho-cleavage process or contain literal search inputs and result counts. They document prior mentions and reuse; they are not independent new record owners.

prior_downstream_curation_provenance.meaning: Next250 source manifests, native pathway projection, complete chemistry closure, curated account, reference bindings and scientific/integration reviews underpin GO:0019618. The native exact label is protocatechuate degradation II (ortho-cleavage pathway), with four native members. Initial and successor review files concern the existing downstream record.

neighbor_route_interface_exclusions.meaning: Quinate I/II and shikimate I curation retain the downstream frame as a separate pathway outside their formal route boundary. These are consistent interface/scope mentions, not evidence that shikimate II is already maintained.

prior_qsu_identity_and_source_context.meaning: Next257 retained R cgR_0492/QsuA and cgR_0495/QsuD identity searches and source receipts. Exact QsuA protein is BAF53459.1; retired Entrez genes were not promoted. PMID23929881 occurs as a Rhea citation and in the ATCC13032 Q9X5C9 UniProt annotation, not as a previously maintained primary reference or an R-strain direct assay. Identity searches do not establish live KEGG gene authority or transport experimentally.

prior_qsu_search_inputs.meaning: Next257 search vocabulary and receipts already contain qsu locus strings and PMID23929881/DOI10.1515/hsz-2013-0170. Search terms and external source bindings establish prior awareness only; they do not show curation or full-paper reading.

prior_ecoli_shia_comparator.meaning: Earlier primary disposition identifies 2009 QsuA transport as inference from 40% identity to E.coli ShiA. This is a different organism and protein than experimentally characterized C.glutamicum R cgR_2523/ShiA.

current_task_test_fixture.meaning: New untracked tests/test_kegg_gene_authority.py in next258 task worktree uses ShiA in adversarial wrong-label/alias tests. This is this task's adapter work, not baseline scientific coverage. No code review is performed in this search task.
